# File Hasher

> File Hasher computes a file's checksum entirely inside your browser. Drop a
> file, get its SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-1 or MD5 digest, and check it
> against a hash the publisher gave you. Nothing is uploaded.

## What it does

- Hashes one or more files with SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-1 or MD5.
- Paste an expected hash, or a full checksum list, and it marks each file as
  matching, mismatched or missing.
- Flags duplicate files that hash the same.
- Exports results as plain text in the standard sha256sum format, CSV, or
  JSON.

## How it works

Hashing runs in the browser using WebAssembly, in a background worker. Files
never leave the computer, and there is no account, no server and no
tracking.

## Pages

- [File Hasher](https://hash.modul4r.com/): drop a file and get its checksum.
